summary: Kami Home 5.0.2 native libraries (arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a), what each does and which Java class loads it.

items.description: ThroughTek (TUTK) IOTC: UID discovery, NAT traversal, relay, sessions. JNI class com.tutk.IOTC.IOTCAPIs (IOTC_Initialize2, IOTC_Connect_ByUID_Parallel, IOTC_Session_Read/Write...). Proprietary, licensed SDK.

evidence.snippet: public static native int IOTC_Connect_ByUID_Parallel(String str, int i10);

items.description: TUTK AV layer on top of IOTC: avClientStart2, avRecvFrameData2, avSendIOCtrl, avRecvIOCtrl. Loaded by com.tutk.IOTC.AVAPIs.

evidence.snippet: public static native int avClientStart2(int i10, String str, String str2, int i11, int[] iArr, int i12, int[] iArr2);

items.description: YI 'TNP' P2P transport (namespace tnp::PPPP_Proto_*, DevLgn/P2PServerReq/ConnectReport messages). JNI class com.p2p.pppp_api.PPPP_APIs (PPPP_Initialize, PPPP_Connect, PPPP_Read, PPPP_Write, PPPP_CheckDevOnline). Used by com.tnp.TnpCamera. Loaded by name from AntsApplication.

evidence.snippet: public static native int PPPP_Connect(String str, byte b10, int i10, String str2, String str3);

items.description: Langtao (glnk) P2P stack for older cameras, 32-bit only (armeabi-v7a split, absent from arm64). Wrapper package glnk.ants (MyRuntime) and AntsCameraLangtao.
'Phone as camera' (Kami mobile IPC): encoder feed, motion, cloud recorder, p2p_service. Not the viewer path. JNI class com.kami.mobileipc.KamiMobileIPC.

evidence.snippet: static native int nativeFeedVideo(int i10, byte[] bArr, int i11, int i12, int i13, int i14, int i15, int i16, long j10);

items.description: Players, decoders and muxers (FFmpeg-based). libyimedia = Hls2Mp4 (cloud clip conversion). A desktop client replaces these with FFmpeg.
items.library: libijkffmpeg, libijkplayer, libijksdl, libavcodec/avformat/avutil/swscale, libh265decoder, libfaad, libG726Android, libFFmpegUtil, libFFMuxing, libtranscode, libyimedia

items.description: Echo cancellation / AGC / encoders for talk-back. Only needed for two-way audio.
items.library: libwebrtc_apm, libwebrtc_audio_preprocessing, libaudioproc, libmi_aec, libpcmjni, libVoAACEncoder, libpcm

items.description: UI/analytics/recording support. libapp.so is the Flutter AOT module (assets/flutter_assets: activity/health icons); its Dart code is not decompiled by JADX and was not analysed. The REST and P2P code found is in the Java layer.
items.library: libflutter, libapp (Dart AOT), libtensorflowlite, libMotionMagnifier, libsxpen, libmp4recorder, libmp4v2, libcrypto, libssl, ad/crash SDK libs

evidence.snippet: Flutter module present; Dart AOT in libapp.so
